title: Canonical scalar-extension arrows on cochain representatives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A\to B$ be a unital map of commutative rings and use ordinary constant-ring module sheaves and derived categories on its small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $E_t$ for ordinary sheafified scalar extension, $U_t$ for its exact restriction right adjoint, and $L_t\dashv DU_t$ for the derived scalar adjunction [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension]. For $t=e,p$ and any cochain complex $P$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], define the canonical representative arrow $r_{t,P}:L_t(QP)\to Q(E_tP)$ to be the transpose under $L_t\dashv DU_t$ of the composite $QP\xrightarrow{Q(\eta_{t,P})}Q(U_tE_tP)\xrightarrow{\sim}DU_t(Q(E_tP))$, where $\eta_t$ is the ordinary scalar unit and the second arrow is the inverse of the exact-localization factorization. Also retain on the pro-etale site the functors $L_p$, $DU_p$ and the coefficient sheaf $U_p(B_X)$, where $B_X$ is the tensor unit in $B$-module sheaves. These definitions impose no flatness, boundedness, finiteness or geometric hypothesis and do not assert that $r_{t,P}$ is invertible.

def proScalarExtensionRepresentative
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    (proFixedScalar φ T).obj (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
      _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((ProEtale.sheafExtendScalars φ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
